title: Canto IV
wikitext:
'''Canto IV''' is a story chapter focused on [[Yi Sang]] and events around K Corp. It re-establishes his history with [[Dongrang]] and the [[League of Nine]].

== Summary ==
The sinners confront conflicts tied to K Corp. and Dongrang. The canto establishes how Yi Sang and Dongrang were once collaborators, how the League of Nine fell apart, and how those past ties shape the present conflict.

* [[Dongrang]]
* [[League of Nine]]
